name: ainet_free_all
description: AINet::FreeAll repeatedly removes the global head AINet, frees it, and reloads the global head until the list is empty.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the /MD CRT import-call AINet source target; g_AINetListHead is a zero-initialized BSS global in Binary Ninja/original data and source.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x403870 loads g_AINetListHead from 0x4e5c58, stores the current head's next pointer back to that global before each free, calls AINet::Free on the removed head, reloads the global head, and repeats until null.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x403870 has no warnings or tags and shows the same global-list removal loop and AINet::Free call.
The dependency frontier for 0x403870 has no visible source blockers after accepting AINet::Free.
The native ainet_free_all_smoke builds a two-entry global AINet list with an owned node chain and verifies AINet::FreeAll leaves g_AINetListHead null.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x403870 --build-root build\vc5-verify-403870-probe passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 16 relocation-masked bytes under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 34, VC object symbol size 48, 14 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
